modeling_decisions: Actual concept inspected: retain broad below-grade bowl, low rim and shallow apron. Reject excessive tiny rocks and rings of decorative texture. Radial heightfield has continuous irregular slopes, no raised cone/stacked concentric staircases. Country20m, deepest floor6m, rim maxabout22m; footprint120x110m. Low-relief naturally irregular perimeter and closed cutaway side/underside. Palette distinguishes dark ejecta from exposed tan country wall without claiming mineral composition. No eruptions, smoke, lava, lake, vegetation or site replica.
